description: The Latvia University of Life Sciences and Technologies publishes responses from 1,336 households on food waste. The questionnaire ran from 6 June 2024 through 30 January 2025 and covers shopping habits, leftover handling, waste-management opinions and household characteristics. Mendeley Data provides version two for free under CC BY-NC-ND 4.0. The survey can help calibrate household food-waste behaviour or test assumptions in municipal collection and food-supply simulations. Social-media and broadcast recruitment did not establish a probability sample; comparisons across locations or ages therefore require care. The no-derivatives condition also constrains redistribution of adapted data. Individual records, formats and possible missing answers were not inspected. No directly related catalogue dataset was identified.
